violated_contract: A matcher used to include or exclude work from a gate must not treat a pattern that matches zero paths as success. Matching nothing is fail-open: the class, check, or candidate disappears and the author proceeds as if the matcher had a real target.
canonical_prevention: Fail closed when a newly added matcher hits zero tracked paths. FailureClassCliTests.test_scope_hint_matching_zero_paths_is_error drives scripts/failure-class prepare and validate with a scope_hint that matches nothing and asserts exit 1 with scope_hint_matches_nothing, not a warning or a pass.
